title: What Is Capital in Business? Types, Sources, and How to Get It in the Philippines
summary: Capital is one of the most misunderstood terms in business. It can refer to the money a founder puts into a company, the assets a business uses to operate, or the resources available to fund growth. These are related, but they are not the same thing. Understanding the difference matters when deciding how to fund a business.
